status.description: skipped = harness policy noop (e.g. read_after_complete); not a tool failure.

policy.description: Optional policy id when status=skipped (read_after_complete, read_overlap, read_budget).

chars_read.description: CTX-9: characters returned in this read_file window (not full file dump on the event).

file_chars.description: CTX-9: total characters of the source file when known (for coverage = chars_read cumulative / file).

next_offset.description: Continuation line for truncated read_file; omit when complete.

path.description: Workspace path for write_file / edit_file (projection / Ops).

old_text.description: Prior span or file preview for write/edit (sticky apply without approval.requested).

new_text.description: New span or file preview for write/edit.

subagent_id.description: Present when the event originates from a nested delegate sub-agent.
